<CE-01>display interface brief
PHY: Physical
*down: administratively down
^down: standby
(l): loopback
(s): spoofing
(b): BFD down
(B): Bit-error-detection down
(e): ETHOAM down
(d): Dampening Suppressed
(p): port alarm down
(ld): loop-detect trigger down
(mf): mac-flapping blocked
(sd): standby down
InUti/OutUti: input utility rate/output utility rate
